description: A portal access grant binds only a live contact of the path tenant. Run from apps/server: npx vitest run test/portal-grant-tenant.integration.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-33-vitest.json against a migrated local database and REDIS_URL, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/portal-grant-tenant.json --report .proof/r0-33-vitest.json. Cases tagged NEGATIVE CONTROL, the soft-deleted case and the service case fail on the unmodified code (c2f6f46d and the R0 working branch before this packet).
requiredCases: fixture sanity (real rows) seeded two tenants, their contacts and one grant each
POST /portal/businesses/:businessId/access binds only a contact of the path tenant NEGATIVE CONTROL (pre-fix FAIL expected): A's owner granting B's contact on A's path answers 404 and writes no row

POST /portal/businesses/:businessId/access binds only a contact of the path tenant NEGATIVE CONTROL (pre-fix FAIL expected): a foreign contact id answers byte-identically to an unknown id, and neither writes a row

POST /portal/businesses/:businessId/access binds only a contact of the path tenant NEGATIVE CONTROL (pre-fix FAIL expected): the reverse — B's owner granting A's contact on B's path — answers 404 and writes no row
POST /portal/businesses/:businessId/access binds only a contact of the path tenant NEGATIVE CONTROL (pre-fix FAIL expected): B's tenant state is byte-identical after A's attempts on B's contact

POST /portal/businesses/:businessId/access binds only a contact of the path tenant NEGATIVE CONTROL (pre-fix FAIL expected): a request with no contactId, or a non-string one, binds nothing and answers like an unknown id
POST /portal/businesses/:businessId/access binds only a contact of the path tenant a soft-deleted contact of A is not a contact of A: 404, no row
POST /portal/businesses/:businessId/access binds only a contact of the path tenant the service refuses a foreign contact itself, so the KEY flow and storelink callers are bound too
POST /portal/businesses/:businessId/access binds only a contact of the path tenant positive control: A's owner granting A's own contact answers 201 and writes one row bound to A
POST /portal/businesses/:businessId/access binds only a contact of the path tenant positive control: B granting its own contact on its own path still answers 201 (re-grant of its existing row)

POST /portal/businesses/:businessId/access binds only a contact of the path tenant re-granting an existing grant of an A contact behaves as before: same row, fresh token, enabled, 90 days, settings kept
the guards in front of the grant are unchanged anonymous answers 401 and a member of another tenant answers 403; neither writes a row
